verdict.rationale: Deepgram's own Audio Intelligence features (summarization, sentiment analysis, topic detection, intent recognition) generate AI insights from a user's audio data, and the dg CLI can 'analyze text'. These are only briefly described and are delivered through the API/CLI rather than shown as in-product insights or suggestions. missing for 10: in-product (dashboard/console) insight surfacing, AI-generated suggestions or recommendations, in-depth documentation of the insight features, independent or hands-on corroboration.
